title: Show Your Assumptions and Build with Clarity
primary_theme: Health Investing with Empathy, Assumption Testing, and Patient Capital
founder_lessons: Meet investors with empathy, but make your key assumptions and metrics explicit.
Use investor meetings to ask technical and competitive questions, even when funding is unlikely.
Choose investors whose temperament matches the stepwise value-creation curve of health businesses.
Do not import fast-fail software heuristics blindly into sectors where patient lives are at stake.
notable_quotes: The first thing at Stanford medicine that they teach you is to meet the patient where they are at.
Distill what are the three main metrics that the founder's presented and what are the assumptions he's making
the software does not eat the world when it's patients' life is on the line
